description: List a saved schema's database registrations, linked schemas, options and sync hosts. Returns pending and quarantined delta counts, projection_upgrade_pending and database links. No LLM call. Pending zero alone does not prove healthy delivery: check quarantine and migration blockers. Use list_entity_states for server-side rows and get_record for per-record delivery state. PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite delivery is performed by the user's sync client. See enricher://docs/database-sync.
name: list_database_syncs
title: List database syncs
